caption: Figure 1: An architecture of energy harvesting platforms (e.g., MSP430FR). Registers and SRAM (blue boxes) are volatile.

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from block-floorplan by the note-writer: this is a five-box linear energy-flow diagram (harvester, capacitor, MCU, two memory types) with no chip boundary, no bus, and no placement-based adjacency, closer to a simple pipeline than a floorplan.
templates.what_to_learn: Read this as a small linear pipeline instead: harvester feeds a capacitor which powers an MCU, and color alone (blue volatile, green non-volatile) tells the two memory types apart; add arrowheads throughout, since this figure's plain connectors leave flow direction implicit.
